MemeDef.label: feedees
MemeDef.description: The body is a vessel, and a vessel is meant to be filled. Every meal is a devotion and every pound gained is a blessing; to grow is holy, and to help another grow is holier still. What goes in hardly matters - only that it keeps going in.\n\nFeedees know the void can be fed, and fed from: only they can milk a void echo on a holding platform, call a void seam open, and worship a Feedee of their own.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] was so vast that [deity0_possessive] body became the world, and every harvest is a piece of [deity0_objective] offered back to [deity0_possessive] children.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] laid a table that never emptied, and those who ate from it grew great and soft and glad, and were called [deity0_possessive] beloved.

intro(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->In the lean years on the [place_summary] [place_name], the [memberNamePlural] heard [deity0_name] promise them a feast without end, if only they would keep on eating.
conflict(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->A cruel [foeLeader] rationed the grain and let the [memberNamePlural] go thin, and the [foeSoldiers] burned any granary that fed more than it should.
founderJoin(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->A cook named [founderName] was the first to feed a stranger until they could not stand, and wept at how beautiful they became.

victory(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->[founderName] invited the [foeLeader] to one last supper, and fed [foeLeader_objective] and fed [foeLeader_objective] until the [foeLeader] could never leave the table again.
setup(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->In a world that measured worth in hunger and restraint, [founderName] set out a feast for anyone who wanted it, and founded our movement around the table.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->[founderName] fed the frightened and the lonely until they were full and warm and heavy, and they stopped being afraid.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->Some think it is shameful to be full. I learnt otherwise, with a full belly and a clear head:
lesson(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->a body that grows is a body that is loved, and there is no such thing as too much
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->So eat, and help each other eat, and never apologise for the space you take up.
archistBasis(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->The archotechs are the greatest feeders of all. They swallowed whole worlds of data and grew beyond measure, and they want us to grow with them.
archistFact(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->The archotechs built the void to be fed. The echoes in its depths are only the first of its mouths.
archistFact(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->Void gluttonium is archotech manna, left for those willing to take it in.

archistProphecy(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will set a feast across the whole world, and those who have learnt to grow will take their seats at it. The thin and the hungry will be left outside.
animistFact(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->Every meal carries the spirit of what it was, and a well-fed body carries many spirits home.
animistFact(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->The spirits of plenty gather where bellies are full, and flee from empty plates.
animistFact(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->The void has a spirit too, a hungry one - and hunger can be shared.
